enums.name: Trouble
enums.docs: A typed error that is a C-like enum.

enums.name: Mode
enums.docs:
A loudness level. Two discriminants are explicit and the third is
implicit.

records.name: Refusal
records.docs: A typed error that is a struct.

records.name: Settings
records.docs: A struct with one field of each supported type.

records.name: Empty
records.docs: A data value whose encoding still occupies one byte.

records.name: Choices
records.docs: Sets nested in a record and a list.

records.name: TupleData
records.docs: Tuple fields, including a nested pair and a list of one-element tuples.

records.name: Defaults
records.docs: Fields whose omitted values are constructed by Rust.

tagged.name: Event
tagged.docs: An event: a tagged enum whose variants carry different fields.

tagged.name: CountError
tagged.docs: Why a count was rejected: a typed error with one variant per reason.

interfaces.name: Counter
interfaces.docs: An integer counter, with one method for each feature a binding supports.

methods.name: fill
methods.docs:
Returns `count` bytes, each set to the value's low byte. Fails for a
negative count.

methods.name: add
methods.docs:
Adds `amount` to the value and returns the new value. Fails on
overflow. A locked counter leaves the value unchanged.

methods.name: adds
methods.docs: The number of adds made, as an atomic the host reads directly.

methods.name: locked
methods.docs: A flag that makes the counter ignore adds while it is set.

methods.name: work
methods.docs:
Does `units` of work, incrementing `progress` for each unit, and stops
early once `cancel` is set. Returns the number of units done.

methods.name: consume
methods.docs: Adds `other`'s value, consuming it, and returns the new value.

methods.name: split
methods.docs: `parts` new counters, starting at this one's value and counting up.

methods.name: stamp
methods.docs: Writes the value's low byte into every byte of `data`.

methods.name: set
methods.docs: Sets the value, negated if `negate` is set.

methods.name: absorb
methods.docs: Adds another counter's value to this one.

methods.name: swap
methods.docs: Swaps values with another counter.

methods.name: fork
methods.docs: A new counter starting at this one's value.

methods.name: larger
methods.docs:
Returns a counter holding the larger of the two values, or `None` if
`other` is `None`.

methods.name: into_value
methods.docs: Consumes the counter and returns its value.

methods.name: into_value_later
methods.docs:
Consumes the counter in an async function that returns its value
later.

methods.name: live
methods.docs: The number of live counters.

methods.name: fail
methods.docs: Panics, to test how a binding handles a panic.

methods.name: nap
methods.docs: Sleeps, to stand in for a blocking call.

methods.name: each
methods.docs:
Calls `f` with each number from 1 to `count` and half that number,
and stops at the first failure.

methods.name: test
methods.docs: Returns the result of calling `f` with the value.

methods.name: scaled_by
methods.docs:
Returns the result of calling `f` with half the value and whether
the value is odd.

methods.name: described
methods.docs:
Calls `f` with a name and the value and returns its result. The
callback takes a borrowed string and returns an owned one.

methods.name: words
methods.docs: Returns the number of words in `text` for which `f` returns true.

methods.name: titled
methods.docs: Returns the number of characters in the string `f` returns.

methods.name: chunks
methods.docs:
Calls `f` with the value's bytes in chunks of `size`, and returns the
number of bytes passed.

methods.name: spawn_each
methods.docs:
Creates `count` counters with values 1, 2 and so on, and passes
ownership of each to `f`. Returns the sum of `f`'s return values.

methods.name: ask
methods.docs: Returns what `f` returns.

methods.name: from_fn
methods.docs: Returns a counter starting at the value `f` returns.

methods.name: attempt
methods.docs:
Returns what `f` returns, or -1 if it fails. Here the library
discards the callback's error.

methods.name: apply
methods.docs:
Replaces the value with `f(value)`, `times` times. Stops at the first
failure and keeps the value from the last successful call.

methods.name: version
methods.docs:
Returns the library's name and version. A function with no `class`
argument becomes a static method of the class named after the library,
which here is the `Counter` class.

interfaces.name: Job
interfaces.docs:
Work on a thread the library starts, monitored and stopped through two
atomics.

methods.name: new
methods.docs: Starts counting to `units`, one per millisecond.

interfaces.name: Tally
interfaces.docs:
A running total of counters: an interface whose methods accept and
return another interface.

methods.name: record
methods.docs: Adds a counter's value to the total and returns it.

methods.name: to_counter
methods.docs: A counter starting at the total.

interfaces.name: Later
interfaces.docs:
Asynchronous results as the generator binds them: a class of static
functions with no instance.

methods.name: square
methods.docs: The square of `value`, after a delay.

methods.name: sum
methods.docs: The sum of 1 to `limit`, adding one term per step.

methods.name: combined
methods.docs: One async task that awaits `square` and `sum` and adds the results.

methods.name: counter
methods.docs:
A counter created by the task and transferred to the caller when the
result is taken.

methods.name: pot
methods.docs: The same for a shared value.

methods.name: counter_batch
methods.docs: A batch created on a worker and transferred when the future is taken.

methods.name: batch_later
methods.docs: A batch returned by an async function, or a failure before it is made.

methods.name: pot_batch
methods.docs: Two references to the same shared value in one asynchronous batch.

methods.name: counter_batches
methods.docs: Batches in order, including an empty one, followed by a failure.

methods.name: pot_batches
methods.docs: A stream batch whose elements share one value.

methods.name: abandoned
methods.docs: A future that is never settled.

methods.name: checked
methods.docs:
Returns an error immediately for a negative limit, and otherwise
behaves as `sum`.

methods.name: count_up
methods.docs:
Yields 1 to `limit` one item at a time, then ends or, with `fail`,
fails.

methods.name: counters
methods.docs: A stream of `count` counters with values 1, 2 and so on.

methods.name: squared
methods.docs: `square` as an async function: the function body is the task.

methods.name: maybe_counter
methods.docs:
String and byte parameters of an async function are owned copies,
because it runs after the call that passed them has returned.
A counter at `value` once some time has passed, or none for 0.

methods.name: total_later
methods.docs:
The sum of two counters' values, taking both, once some time has
passed.

methods.name: settle
methods.docs: Returns no value, only completion.

methods.name: agree
methods.docs: Returns no value, or an error.

methods.name: counted
methods.docs: A counter created by an async function.

methods.name: stamp
methods.docs:
A timestamp derived from `value`: a future that resolves to a 64-bit
integer.

methods.name: frame
methods.docs: `count` bytes, each set to `fill`, created by the async function.

methods.name: frames
methods.docs: A stream of frames with lengths from 1 to `count` bytes.

methods.name: odometer
methods.docs:
A signal of a count that does not fit in 32 bits, updated as it
increases.

methods.name: ticks
methods.docs:
A stream of `count` unit items. Each carries no data and only reports
that something happened.

methods.name: ramp
methods.docs: A signal whose value increases from 0 to `limit`.

methods.name: label
methods.docs: The same, with the value as a string.

interfaces.name: Pot
interfaces.docs:
A total with several contributors. It is shared: the library and any
number of Haxe objects hold references to the same value, which lives
until the last reference is dropped.

methods.name: add
methods.docs: Adds to the total and returns it.

methods.name: add_later
methods.docs:
Adds after a delay. An async method of a shared value holds a
reference to it while it runs, whatever happens to the object it was
called on.

methods.name: pour
methods.docs: Adds another pot's total, and a third pot's total if one is given.

methods.name: offer
methods.docs:
Passes `f` a reference to `pot` and a new pot holding half its total,
and adds `f`'s return value to the total.

methods.name: split
methods.docs:
A separate pot starting at this one's total, returned as a shared
reference.

methods.name: pair
methods.docs: Two new pots, holding this one's total and twice it.

methods.name: live
methods.docs: The number of live pots, regardless of how many references each has.

interfaces.name: Player
interfaces.docs: A player that pays into a pot and holds a shared reference to it.

methods.name: pay
methods.docs: Adds to the pot and returns its total.

methods.name: pot
methods.docs:
The pot this player pays into. Each call returns a reference to the
same pot.

methods.name: pays_into
methods.docs: Whether this player pays into `pot`.

methods.name: move_to
methods.docs:
Switches to another pot, or keeps the current one if given `None`.
Returns the previous pot.

methods.name: fuller
methods.docs:
A new pot holding the larger total of this player's pot and `other`,
or `None` if `other` is `None`.

interfaces.name: Blob
interfaces.docs:
A byte buffer the garbage collector cannot see, whose size is reported
to it. To the host, a blob is a few words regardless of how much native
memory it holds.

methods.name: copy
methods.docs: A copy of this blob with the same bytes and the same reported size.

methods.name: live
methods.docs: The number of live blobs.

methods.name: crowded
methods.docs: Asks the host to run a garbage collection at its next opportunity.

interfaces.name: Events
interfaces.docs: Static functions over events, with no instance.

methods.name: depth
methods.docs: The nesting depth of the events in `event`.

methods.name: show
methods.docs: A string showing the event as the library received it.

methods.name: history
methods.docs: One event of each variant.

methods.name: wrapped
methods.docs: The event wrapped `times` times.

methods.name: inverted
methods.docs:
The names keyed by their counts. Takes a hash map and returns a
sorted map.

methods.name: checked
methods.docs: The count, or a typed error giving the reason it was rejected.

methods.name: mode_named
methods.docs: The mode called `name`, or an error carrying the name.

methods.name: refuse
methods.docs: Returns no value, or a struct error describing the refusal.

methods.name: trouble
methods.docs: The level, or the `Trouble` that level corresponds to.

methods.name: checked_later
methods.docs:
A future that resolves to a struct, or fails with the typed error of
the task that would have produced it.

methods.name: mode_later
methods.docs: A future that resolves to an enum.

methods.name: small_later
methods.docs: A future that resolves to a narrow integer.

methods.name: path_later
methods.docs: A future that resolves to a list of structs.

methods.name: maybe_later
methods.docs: A future that resolves to an optional number.

methods.name: feed
methods.docs: A stream of the first `count` events of `history`.

methods.name: mode_now
methods.docs: A signal of a mode that changes from quiet to off.

methods.name: place_now
methods.docs: A signal of a point whose `x` increases until it reaches `limit`.

methods.name: each_point
methods.docs:
The result of `f` for each point. The callback takes a borrowed
struct and returns an enum.

methods.name: reshaped
methods.docs:
The event `f` returns for `event`. The callback takes an owned event
and returns one.

methods.name: picked
methods.docs:
The point `f` picks, if any. The callback takes a list borrowed as a
slice, and an enum.

methods.name: stamped
methods.docs: The bytes `f` returns for 1, followed by the bytes it returns for 2.

methods.name: graded
methods.docs:
The result of `f` for quiet. The callback takes an enum and returns
one, with no other values.

interfaces.name: Numbers
interfaces.docs:
Integer types narrower than the wire types, unsigned types, and 64-bit
types.

methods.name: inverted
methods.docs: `bits` with every bit inverted.

methods.name: doubled
methods.docs: Twice `count`, which may be too large to convert back.

methods.name: map_wide
methods.docs: Passes all 64 bits to `f` and returns its result.

methods.name: wide_from
methods.docs: Takes a 64-bit value from a callback with no parameters.

methods.name: describe_wide
methods.docs: Passes borrowed text and a 64-bit value in the same callback.

methods.name: squared
methods.docs: The square of `value`, which may not fit in 32 bits.

methods.name: inverted_wide
methods.docs: `bits` with all 64 bits inverted.

methods.name: third
methods.docs: A third of `value`, at `f32` precision.

methods.name: sized
methods.docs: A length the library validates after the binding has accepted it.

interfaces.name: Shapes
interfaces.docs: Static functions over data types, with no instance.

methods.name: describe
methods.docs:
A string showing the struct as the library received it. Takes the
struct by reference.

methods.name: bumped
methods.docs: Takes a struct by value and returns it modified.

methods.name: louder
methods.docs: The mode one step louder.

methods.name: named
methods.docs: An enum taken by reference.

methods.name: mode_of
methods.docs: The mode with discriminant `number`, if there is one.

methods.name: choices
methods.docs: Returns its own copy of the choices.

methods.name: empty_values
methods.docs: Empty records are valid elements of a list and of a set.

methods.name: unique_values
methods.docs: Removes duplicates and returns the values in order.

methods.name: unique_bytes
methods.docs: A set of bytes is a set of numbers, rather than a byte buffer.

methods.name: set_later
methods.docs: A set transferred when an asynchronous result is taken.

methods.name: set_signal
methods.docs: A set held as a signal's final value.

methods.name: mapped_set
methods.docs: A Haxe function receives and returns set elements as arrays.

methods.name: scaled_modes
methods.docs: Scales a table keyed by the library's enum.

methods.name: modes_later
methods.docs: The same table through an asynchronous result.

methods.name: mapped_modes
methods.docs: A table passed to and returned from a lent Haxe function.

methods.name: midpoint
methods.docs: The midpoint of two points, one taken by value and one by reference.

methods.name: right_of
methods.docs: The first point to the right of `x`, from a slice parameter.

methods.name: total
methods.docs: The sum of a list of numbers.

methods.name: doubled
methods.docs: Doubles an optional number, if it is present.

methods.name: words
methods.docs: The words of `text`.

methods.name: preset
methods.docs: Returns a struct, or an error.

methods.name: counter
methods.docs:
A counter starting at the struct's `count`. Takes data and returns an
object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.docs:
Clamps `value` to the range `low` to `high`. Fails if `low` is greater
than `high`.

methods.name: total
methods.docs: Returns the sum of two counters' values.

methods.name: copy
methods.docs:
Copies as much of `from` as fits into `into`, and returns how many bytes
it copied.

methods.name: starting_at
methods.docs: Creates a counter from a free function instead of a `Counter` method.

methods.name: halve
methods.docs:
Half of `value`: a free function in a submodule, bound to a class the
library names.
